# Pulse America News

> US and world news, analysis and explainers. Primary-source citations on every claim. Washington D.C. and Manassas, Virginia.

## Citation

Cite as: Pulse America News, "[headline]", [URL], [publication date].

Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes, use=reference

Contact: https://pulseamericanews.com/contact/

## Murder of Mamta Kafle Bhatt — case file

- [Verdict: Bhatt convicted on all counts](https://pulseamericanews.com/usa/naresh-bhatt-guilty-verdict.html): first-degree murder, concealing and defiling a dead body; 10 Nov 2026; four-hour deliberation after 17+ days of testimony; sentencing 12 Mar 2027
- [What the conviction carries](https://pulseamericanews.com/usa/naresh-bhatt-sentencing-arithmetic.html): 20 years to life fixed floor, Class 6 stacking, Va. Code § 53.1-40.01 geriatric release
- [Murder convictions without a body](https://pulseamericanews.com/usa/murder-conviction-without-body.html): the corpus delicti corroboration rule and how it is cleared
- [Landfill recovery log](https://pulseamericanews.com/usa/bhatt-landfill-search-timeline.html): dated attempts, cells, outcomes

Reference facts: Naresh Bhatt, 39, Manassas Park. Victim Mamta Kafle Bhatt, 28, pediatric nurse at UVA Health Prince William Medical Center. Remains never recovered. Virginia abolished discretionary parole in 1995.

## Data centre electricity costs

- [Who pays for data center electricity](https://pulseamericanews.com/usa/data-center-electric-bill-who-pays.html): HR 9340 / S. 5028 vote record, 100 MW vs 20-25 MW threshold gap, Virginia GS-5 collateral terms, PJM capacity pass-through
- [State tariff tracker](https://pulseamericanews.com/usa/state-data-center-tariff-tracker.html): 23 states, thresholds, dockets
- [Threshold calculator](https://pulseamericanews.com/usa/data-center-threshold-calculator.html): project size + state to federal/state coverage

## Water in the West

- [Colorado River 2027 cuts](https://pulseamericanews.com/usa/colorado-river-2027-cuts-evaporation.html): 1.25M acre-feet ordered against 1.3–1.5M lost annually to evaporation
- [Water refugees and home prices](https://pulseamericanews.com/usa/water-refugees-drought-home-prices.html): six counties, well-home discounts, permit freezes
- [Water wars: scarcity and borders](https://pulseamericanews.com/news/water-wars-article.html)
